type: B2B services (executive search) — HIGHLY TRANSFERABLE 'Swiss modular grid' concept, no WebGL
concept: Swiss modular grid: the page is a table. Every block is a cell with 1px ink borders; cells are filled with flat colour (mint #A8FFCB, ink #222, white, grey #D9D9D9) or halftone-dithered imagery.

fonts.display: condensed grotesk uppercase, ~140px, line-height 0.85, right/left ragged
fonts.labels: mono 11-12px uppercase with ■ square bullet, counters '01 — 06'

moves: header is a grid row: logo cell | local time cell | nav cell | theme toggle | Contact cell (ink)
hero: 2x2 grid of colour cells with 1-line labels bottom-right ('Range of recent offers') + giant headline cell
big-number cells (500+ Placements since 2006) as their own grid cells
services: dark cells numbered 01.. with line-drawn illustration + title + paragraph
clients: left ink cell with logo + counter 01—06, right list rows 'Headlands | QUANT FINANCE' with hairlines
testimonial: photo cell | giant quote text (48px) | meta cell (Position / Company in mono) | halftone cell
team: B/W portraits with mint name cells + arrow
halftone/dither texture of the logo as full-width decorative band
footer: 'Raise your trajectory' cell | nav cell | clocks NYC/LA cell | email/LinkedIn cells | giant wordmark on ink | mint 'Let's start a conversation' cell with huge arrow
masked line reveal on headlines (lines slide up inside clipped containers)
mobile: grid collapses to single column of cells; mint Menu bar; same textures
rules_derived: grid-as-design: visible 1px borders make even plain text feel designed
colour is applied per-cell, never as page background gradients
local time + theme toggle = cheap 'alive' details
halftone/dither = texture move for B2B without photos
every cell has exactly one job
